Class MenuBoutOptions

java.lang.Object
org.app.consoleMenu.boutMenu.MenuBoutOptions
public class MenuBoutOptions extends Object
The MenuBoutOptions class provides the logic for handling bout-related operations such as listing all bouts, adding new bouts, simulating a bout, or querying bouts by specific criteria.

This class interacts with the BoutService to manage bouts and CharacterService to fetch characters that participate in bouts.

  • Method Details

    • listAllBouts

      public void listAllBouts()
      Lists all bouts stored in the database by fetching them from the BoutService. Displays the bouts in the console, or notifies the user if no bouts are found.

    • addNewBout

      public void addNewBout(Scanner scanner)
      Adds a new bout to the database. The user is prompted to input the bout's key, tourney name, attacker and defender keys, and the points for both the attacker and defender. The bout is added if valid character keys are provided.
      Parameters:
      scanner - Scanner for capturing user input.

    • simulateBout

      public void simulateBout(Scanner scanner)
      Simulates a bout by generating points for the attacker and defender using the BoutMaker class. The user is prompted to enter bout details such as keys for both the attacker and defender.
      Parameters:
      scanner - Scanner for capturing user input.

    • queryBoutsByTourney

      public void queryBoutsByTourney(Scanner scanner)
      Queries and displays all bouts in a specific tourney. The user is prompted to enter the tourney name, and the corresponding bouts are displayed.
      Parameters:
      scanner - Scanner for capturing user input.

    • queryBoutsByTourneyAndAttacker

      public void queryBoutsByTourneyAndAttacker(Scanner scanner)
      Queries and displays all bouts in a specific tourney where a given character is the attacker. The user is prompted to enter the tourney name and the attacker's key.
      Parameters:
      scanner - Scanner for capturing user input.

    • queryBoutByKey

      public void queryBoutByKey(Scanner scanner)
      Queries and displays a bout by its unique bout key. The user is prompted to enter the bout key, and the corresponding bout is displayed if found.
      Parameters:
      scanner - Scanner for capturing user input.
